verdict.rationale: Automations are a fair question for a government filing and records service, which could plausibly offer scheduled filings, auto-renewals or watch alerts, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only one-off actions: filing, emailed PDF receipts, name reservations and an announcements signup. Nothing documents a user-configurable automation that runs on a recurring schedule or in the background, and probes found no API, OpenAPI spec or agent-accessible filing host.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
